name: get_events
description: Fetch recent events from a PostHog project. Returns event names, timestamps, and properties. Example: get_events({ project_id: "12345", limit: 50, _apiKey: "phx_..." })

name: get_persons
description: Search for persons (users) in a PostHog project. Returns user profiles with properties. Example: get_persons({ project_id: "12345", search: "john@example.com", _apiKey: "phx_..." })

search.description: Optional search query to filter persons by email, name, or distinct ID

name: get_insights
description: List saved insights (charts, trends, funnels) for a PostHog project. Returns insight names, types, and configurations. Example: get_insights({ project_id: "12345", _apiKey: "phx_..." })
